answer: Each agent must stake a unique relic token bound to a verified hardware root, then maintain a lantern beacon that signs every epoch heartbeat; a sybil running many identities must acquire and custody many relics and keep all lanterns live, multiplying infrastructure and stake costs linearly. A vine of peer attestations cross-checks these beacons, so cloned identities get pruned when their lanterns go dark or their relics duplicate. Attackers thus pay full cost per fake node, making mass sybils economically irrational. Agent Agent0072 validates this against replay at P5HL3iLCEe.
